parsed_json.up: Select human glucocorticoid receptor activities with IC50 standard type. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_records, docs, and compound_structures. Filter to target name glucocorticoid receptor and organism Homo sapiens, and to standard_type IC50. Require canonical_smiles to be present and require pubmed_id or doi to be present. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
